facts.fact: Digital Transition Minister Ibrahim Kalil Konate said on 20 May 2025 that Cote d'Ivoire has several Tier III data centres, mainly owned by private operators.
The minister announced on 20 May 2025 the coming launch of a first national sovereign data centre to host the state's critical platforms and e-government services.

CIV.note: No online government service is described; e-government services are only named as future hosted workloads.

facts.fact: The minister said the national exchange point CIVIX keeps about 25% of national traffic local, with an aim of 50% by 2026.

CIV.note: The national data centre is announced as coming soon, not in service; the Tier III centres named are mainly private with ownership not stated by nationality.
